survey: A round wall clock seen almost straight on, hanging flat against a wall with vertical green stripes that is also seen front-on. It has a thick orange torus rim around a flat white dial. On the dial are 12 navy hour bars pointing to the center and a ring of minute dots. In the middle are a hub with a red cap, a navy hour hand pointing near 10, a navy minute hand pointing near 2, and a thin red second hand pointing near 5. The rim and dial are near-perfect circles that share a center, which fits a face-on view. The hour bars and dots are evenly spaced and sized all the way round, which fits a flat dial seen face-on. The rim's drop shadow falls softly onto the wall behind, so the clock reads as sitting flat on the wall. The hands sit flat on the dial and pivot on the hub.
